title: Rate Limiter
text: Limit rate of change of signal, 1 input, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {Initial condition} sets Initial output; {Rising slew rate} limits of derivative for increasing input, {Falling slew rate} limits of derivative for decreasing input, {Sample time mode} and {Treat as gain when linearizing} sets the gain value. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Rising slew rate
params.values: Limit of derivative for increasing input 1 (default) | real number

params.name: Falling slew rate
params.values: Limit of derivative for decreasing input -1 (default) | real number

params.name: Treat as gain when linearizing
params.values: Specify the gain value on (default) | off
